rules.name: Cooling System Active Threshold
rules.description: Activate low-level liquid cooling once cell temperature exceeds 32C.

rules.name: Over-Temperature Rate Throttling
rules.description: Throttle charge/discharge to 0.2C if cells exceed 45C to allow self-cooling.

rules.name: Critical Over-Temp Threshold
rules.description: Execute system shutdown if cell temperature exceeds 55C to prevent thermal runaway.
